scenario_disclosure: The business records and findings are synthetic; ECB FX reference data is real.

actions.action: Reprice and cap discounts for Electronics in Paid Search.
actions.evidence: Electronics contribution changed by EUR -22,731 in 2025Q2.
actions.expected_impact: Recover 1-2 percentage points of contribution margin in the affected mix.
actions.guardrail: Orders and 30-day return rate must not worsen by more than 5% relative.

actions.action: Launch a delivery-SLA recovery plan for DE and the North hub.
actions.evidence: DE contribution changed by EUR -18,406; late delivery is an explicit return driver.
actions.expected_impact: Improve on-time rate toward 94% and reduce late-delivery returns.
actions.guardrail: Shipping cost per fulfilled order may rise by at most EUR 0.50.

actions.action: Prioritize mobile performance remediation in Sweden and the United Kingdom.
actions.evidence: Current-quarter mobile load averages 1,487 ms with 13.4% conversion in those markets.
actions.expected_impact: Improve checkout completion and conversion without increasing media spend.
actions.guardrail: Track conversion with Wilson confidence intervals; avoid causal claims without an experiment.

actions.action: Raise reorder coverage for Electronics in DE.
actions.evidence: Estimated lost revenue is EUR 16,884 with a 11.1% snapshot stockout rate.
actions.expected_impact: Recover lost units while limiting excess inventory.
actions.guardrail: Monitor days of supply and aged stock alongside stockout rate.

methodology_caveats: Scenario findings describe generated commerce operations, not a real company.
Last-touch channel attribution is used for revenue; it is not causal incrementality.
The conversion model is observational and reports association, not causal lift.
Lost revenue from stockouts is an estimate based on generated demand and list price.
Forecast intervals reflect model residuals and do not capture all business uncertainty.
